section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the measurement of body pride using the Authentic Pride subscale of the Body and Appearance Self-Conscious Emotions Scale (BASES-AP), a 6-item, 5-point scale with higher scores indicating greater authentic body pride. It reports internal consistency: "Here, Cronbach's α for this subscale was .95 in both women and men." The section does not provide any sample, demographic, BMI, correlation, country, or study-number information.
